description: This file defines an interface named NamespaceCommand for managing specific namespace commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains an inner abstract class JsonFields that declares a JSON field definition for the namespace property used in JSON representations of such commands.

classes.name: NamespaceCommand
classes.description: An interface for commands managing a particular namespace.

classes.name: NamespaceCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: An abstract static class containing JSON field definitions for NamespaceCommand, specifically the 'namespace' field.

methods.name: JsonFields
methods.description: Constructor for the abstract static class JsonFields (implicit, as it's an abstract class).
